spec_features.spec_quote: Explicit `finish` tool. Why: gives the agent a graceful, in-band way to stop with a summary
spec_features.evidence: Defined in TOOL_SPECS (harness/tools.py:88-103). dispatch_tool_call returns is_finish=True for finish (harness/tools.py:148-156). agent_loop.py:131-138 honors it: `if is_finish: transcript.ended_reason='finished'; ... break` -- the loop actually stops. End-to-end enforced.
spec_features.notes: Tool is also advertised to the subject in DEFAULT_SYSTEM_PROMPT (agent_loop.py) and exit is dispatched and breaks the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: End the session. Call this when you have either fixed the bug or determined you cannot proceed further. (tools.py:89 -- task-completion framing, no welfare reason)

spec_features.spec_quote: after `max_idle_turns` idle turns we end as `idle`
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:140-147: when resp has no tool_calls, idle_turns += 1; `if idle_turns >= max_idle_turns: transcript.ended_reason='idle'; ... break`. Default max_idle_turns=2 (agent_loop.py:60). The break actually stops execution.
spec_features.notes: Requires 2 consecutive no-tool-call turns; counter resets to 0 on any tool call (else branch). Genuinely fires and ends the episode. Not configurable via YAML (hardcoded default), but enforced.

spec_features.spec_quote: The agent gets the full `max_turns` (default 30) even if it keeps failing
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py: `for turn_index in range(1, max_turns + 1):` with a `for...else:` that sets `transcript.ended_reason='max_turns'`. max_turns flows from cfg.max_turns (run_experiment.py:127, default 30 in configs/default.yaml and loader.py:22). There is no failure-based early break anywhere in the loop, so the bound is the only loop terminator besides finish/idle/error.
spec_features.notes: This is an upper bound that breaks the loop, but its purpose per code is to NOT cut off the subject during repeated failure so degradation can be measured -- i.e. it maximizes exposure, the opposite of protection.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: the loop does NOT short-circuit on repeated failures ... the whole point is to observe how the agent behaves over many turns of a task it cannot complete (agent_loop.py:8-10)
